flags.message: The date-cut snapshot (cutoff 2026-06-02) cuts ProceedingsandOrder, but its attorney lists ('Other') appear uncut. They name a court-appointed amicus in support of the judgment below and several merits-stage amici, which probably postdate the cutoff. The cell is forward mode, so this is not leakage, and I weighted it modestly in P(disturbed). It does blur the grant moment versus the briefed moment for merits cells.
